text: The VAT lookup redirects Norway to Finland’s rate and Denmark to Sweden’s, ignoring their own configured rates. Norway is therefore charged 25.5% instead of 25%; Denmark currently matches Sweden at 25%, but the alias is still incorrect. I’ll remove the aliases and add tests that catch both redirects.
